_comment: Every raw source the build uses. fetch_sources.py downloads each one into tools/.cache/ and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs. License evidence for each source is in docs/licenses/ and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.license: CC BY 3.0, verbatim copies only (Tanzil)
CC BY 3.0, verbatim copies only (Tanzil)
cc-by (file header)
Shown in the continuous view since 2026-09-28; explicit permission for the verse text requested (letter 13). Font: embedded KFGQPC license, unmodified
CC BY 4.0, attribution waived inside products (quran-ws); page artwork KFGQPC
Artwork: KFGQPC (free use in software); quran-ws layer CC BY 4.0, attribution waived in products
NO WRITTEN LICENSE. Old 1405H edition (quran.com). Used by Ahmed's decision (2026-09-28) until KFGQPC and Quran Foundation reply. Not re-hosted; the app downloads it from quran.com.

NO WRITTEN LICENSE. Old 1405H edition page images (604 PNG) plus the same ayahinfo_1024.db. Used by Ahmed's decision (2026-09-28) until KFGQPC and Quran Foundation reply. Not re-hosted; the app downloads it from quran.com.

QuranEnc terms: republish without change; credit the publisher (KFGQPC) and QuranEnc.com; state the version; keep updated. No version number is published for this tafsir; the file hash and retrieval date stand in for it.
QuranEnc terms: republish without change; credit Saheeh International and QuranEnc.com; state the version (1.1.2); keep updated.
Pickthall (1930) is in the public domain. Tanzil's copy: non-commercial use (Tibyan is free and non-profit).
mp3quran.net general permission: «All rights are available to everyone, and we allow any visitor or developer to copy any material or use any link»
CC BY 4.0, (c) 2016 Collin Fair

Word timings CC BY 4.0 (QuranLab); the dataset hosts no audio. Upstream Parquet: mahmoud-ali-al-banna/train-00000-of-00001.parquet, SHA-256 f91ea421924b8b6c90e26c51ca79f04a90ffb3641df1805fd35341853375e1d2 (2026-09-29). Measured on everyayah's per-verse files (no license; used by the owner's decision for building and checking only, not shipped)

GNU GPL; verbatim copies only; credit the Quranic Arabic Corpus and link to corpus.quran.com (file header). corpus.quran.com/download/ asks for an e-mail address before the download, so a verbatim GitHub copy is used: byte-identical in three independent repositories (cltk/arabic_morphology_quranic-corpus, bnjasim/quranic-corpus, taziksh/quran-frequencies; git blob b91cec6e95d5e0306550b4aedacc7380dc71152a), header 'Quranic Arabic Corpus (morphology, version 0.4)'

Written permission from Nuqayah (2026-09-28): yes, on condition of no ads and no profit. Covers al-Muyassar fi Gharib al-Quran only, not al-Siraj. No version is published; the SHA-256 and the retrieval date (2026-09-30) identify the copy

OpenITI digitisation CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (digitisation only). Edition: tahqiq Isam al-Humaydan, Dar al-Islah, 2nd ed. 1412/1992; the editor's rights are not covered. Mirrored at tibyan.ahmedhelal.dev/mirror/sources/openiti-wahidi-asbab/

No licence file. README: 'The data in this project is free to use as you see fit', a mention appreciated. Links between verses only (no text). Used under the 2026-09-29 rule while the status is confirmed; mirrored at tibyan.ahmedhelal.dev/mirror/sources/waqar144-mutashabihat/
